blurb: Guests can rent single and double kayaks and canoes to paddle on the Erie Canal between Locks 32 and 33 or take longer trips towards Pittsford. The whitewater park is accessible only to paddlers with prior experience or those who have taken introductory courses through the park. Season passes allow unlimited park access from dawn to dusk with optional gear rental.
